title: Chicken Tikka (Yogurt-Marinated Baked Chicken)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: A classic that's easy despite the overnight marinade. Baked on a tray instead of skewered. Eat as a snack with a squeeze of lime, or with bread or rice and raita.

steps.action: Drain: tie in a clean muslin, cheesecloth, or flat-weave dish cloth; hang from the faucet 30 min to 2 hr, then squeeze lightly:
items: Removes water that would otherwise pool and steam the chicken

steps.action: Mix in; cover and refrigerate 2 to 24 hr (longer is better):
items: 1¾ lb boneless chicken thighs (800 g; breasts ok), in 1 in (2.5 cm) cubes

steps.action: Line a large baking tray with foil; spread over it with a paper towel:
Arrange the chicken close together but not touching; bake 15 min.
Brush with oil, flip, brush the other side; bake 10 min:
items: 2 Tbsp oil (30 ml); a rolled paper towel works if no brush

steps.action: Check: browned with crisp edges, not charred. Taste a piece; if not done, bake 10 min more and repeat.
